portable_path_fix.cause: readlink may return full buffer size without a terminator; appending .home/.config to an almost-PATH_MAX executable path with sprintf overflows the destination. Parent GCC16 observed format-overflow at portable_option:734.
portable_path_fix.implementation: Check readlink full-buffer result before NUL write; checked snprintf rejects formatting failure or truncated .home/.config directory path with EXIT_FAILURE. Existing option and mkdir flow unchanged.
portable_path_fix.callsites: LSP confirmed only calls at runtime.c1697/1698 with constant names home/config. No signature change.
portable_path_fix.verification: Parent actual4094-byte executable --appimage-portable-config returned1 with suffix-overflow message and created no .config. Normal home/config cases returned0. Actual5000-byte path failed earlier absolute-path resolution EXIT127; truncated-readlink guard is NOT tested.

static_pie_specs_order.cause: Actual musl-gcc wrapper appends its musl-gcc.specs after user arguments, overriding the earlier custom *link/*startfile specs; parent observed ET_EXEC despite -static-pie.
static_pie_specs_order.fix: Final runtime Make CC invokes gcc directly with musl-gcc.specs first and static-pie.specs last. The latter selects owned musl rcrt1/crti/crtn and static -pie --no-dynamic-linker; no host CRT/libgcc selection.
static_pie_specs_order.parent_resume: Force Make runtime rebuild with -B because compiler/spec changes are not Makefile prerequisites. Keep the ET_DYN/noINTERP/noNEEDED assertion and -Werror unchanged.
static_pie_specs_order.verification: Parent final bg58 EXIT0 after ordered specs with nondeleted conditional libgcc. Parent verifies ET_DYN/noINTERP/noNEEDED/AI2 and correct owned-musl minimal startup. No worker builds/tests. Earlier ET_EXEC/driver ICE remain historical failed build states only.
static_pie_specs_order.libgcc_spec: Nonempty spec text %{!static:-lgcc} evaluates to no arguments for the required -static invocation. An empty *libgcc body deletes the named spec rather than defining an empty expansion; GCC16 parent execution crashed when that deletion became effective after ordering correction.
static_pie_specs_order.spec_grammar_reference: https://gcc.gnu.org/onlinedocs/gccint/Spec-Files.html (empty named specs are deleted; %{!S:X} emits X only when -S is absent)

configuration.source_modifications: No downstream patch or custom source mutation listed by checksum-matched installed recipe.
configuration.scope: Recipe controls and recorded build dependencies; not historical helper/compiler reproduction.

input_selection.fact: Sixteen tdict-* word-list inputs concatenate through LC_ALL=C sort -u to tdict.txt; link thbrk.abm if absent; remove prior thbrk.tri and invoke the generator.

tool_selection.fact: Dictionary generation enabled by default; resolve trietool-0.2 then trietool.

generator_mapping.scope_limit: This maps upstream source semantics only; it does not attest original generator binary bytes or regenerated libthai dictionary bytes, and the tool/library grant does not establish external word-list license.

source_semantic_facts.fact: libdatrie.la consists of dstring.c, trie-string.c, fileutils.c, darray.c, tail.c, trie.c, alpha-map.c plus twelve headers. Installed public headers are typedefs.h, triedefs.h, alpha-map.h and trie.h. Original libdatrie.map/.def control exports.
Default build/install unconditionally includes trietool, linking libdatrie.la and ICONV_LIBS, plus installed trietool-0.2 symlink. It is not a check-only program.
Unconditional subdirectory traversal covers datrie/tools/man/doc/tests. Retains build-aux/git-version-gen and defines release VERSION rule; uses m4 include path.

AC_INIT obtains package version via build-aux/git-version-gen. Original source declares generated config.h, build-aux and m4 directories, ABI5:1:4 and configuration outputs; documentation options are not a trietool-disable option.

Uses VERSION when present; otherwise Git history/tag context via git describe, including dirty suffix. No VERSION file exists in this raw tag export; Git-context bundle preserves the original tag plus reachable history, without running the helper.
Retains original bootstrap instructions involving libtoolize/autoheader/aclocal/automake/autoconf; no such command executed.

Original author Theppitak Karoonboonyanan, Created2006-08-15; no explicit separate GPL grant. Full command is trietool thbrk add-list -e utf-8 tdict.txt. Global -p/--path defaults to current directory. add-list accepts -e/--encoding followed by encoding and requires list filename; iconv_open converts UTF-8 to UCS-4LE AlphaChar keys. --version prints configured VERSION then exits EXIT_FAILURE.

Loads existing thbrk.tri or creates trie from hexadecimal ranges in thbrk.abm; list input is read-only with 256-byte line buffer, key/data split at tab or comma, default data TRIE_DATA_ERROR(-1), trie_store, then dirty trie_save.     PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/lcms/include")

  target_compile_options(lcms2
    PRIVATE
      # gcc-only flags.
      -Wno-stringop-truncation
      -Wno-strict-aliasing
  )
endif()
# By default LCMS uses sizeof(void*) for memory alignment, but in arm 32-bits we
# can't access doubles not aligned to 8 bytes. This forces the alignment to 8
# bytes.
target_compile_definitions(lcms2
  PRIVATE "-DCMS_PTR_ALIGNMENT=8")

  PUBLIC "-DCMS_NO_REGISTER_KEYWORD=1")

  target_compile_definitions(lcms2
    PUBLIC "-DHAVE_GMTIME_R=1")

  check_symbol_exists(gmtime_s "time.h" HAVE_GMTIME_S)

    target_compile_definitions(lcms2
      PUBLIC "-DHAVE_GMTIME_S=1")
  endif()
endif()

[package]
name = "rav1e"
version = "0.8.1"
authors = ["Thomas Daede <tdaede@xiph.org>"]
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.83.0"
build = "build.rs"
include = [
  "/Cargo.toml",
  "/LICENSE",
  "/PATENTS",
  "/README.md",
  "/build.rs",
  "/cbindgen.toml",
  "/src/**",
]
license = "BSD-2-Clause"
description = "The fastest and safest AV1 encoder"
readme = "README.md"
repository = "https://github.com/xiph/rav1e/"
autobenches = false
autobins = false
default-run = "rav1e"

[features]
unstable = []
channel-api = ["crossbeam"]
decode_test = ["aom-sys"]
decode_test_dav1d = ["dav1d-sys"]
binaries = [
  "ivf",
  "y4m",
  "clap",
  "clap_complete",
  "scan_fmt",
  "fern",
  "console",
  "av-metrics",
  "nom",
]
default = ["binaries", "asm", "threading", "signal_support", "git_version"]
git_version = ["built/git2"]
asm = ["nasm-rs", "cc"]
threading = ["rayon/threads"]
signal_support = ["signal-hook"]
dump_ivf = ["ivf"]
quick_test = []
desync_finder = ["backtrace"]
bench = []
check_asm = []
capi = ["scan_fmt"]
tracing = [

9. ZSTD — selected 1.5.7-2
ELF usr/lib/libzstd.so.1, SHA256 4e61afdf04d80cd25d7689e2fa75f63e53b6fd2029d1edcc683f779e23042121.
Retained packaging/licenses/zstd/zstd-1.5.7.tar.gz SHA256 eb33e51f49a15e023950cd7825ca74a4a2b43db8354825ac24fc1b7ee09e6fa3. Current retained Arch-PKGBUILD is version 1.5.7-3, not installed -2; selects release tar.zst/signature plus commit patch 6af3842118ea5325480b403213b2a9fbed3d3d74.patch SHA256 7c07be222d45718b81fb16f97e611adfeb24efa0712ca77fb1e08f4c67803ec3 (fix manpages). That patch is not in the listed retained zstd directory. It also changes test static/shared CMake selection, adds -ffat-lto-objects and enables ZLIB/LZMA/LZ4/CONTRIB/tests, shared-program links, static=OFF. These options for tools/tests are not proof libzstd itself embeds those codec libraries. build/cmake/lib/CMakeLists.txt selects common/compress/decompress/dictBuilder, AMD64 assembly when supported and legacy v01..v07 when enabled.
Actual chosen scope: lib/zstd.h explicitly offers BSD-style LICENSE OR GPLv2 COPYING. Root LICENSE and installed/LICENSE are the complete Meta Platforms BSD-3-Clause grant/disclaimer, SHA256 7055266497633c9025b777c78eb7235af13922117480ed5c674677adc381c9d8. Real current lib/common/xxhash.h carries Yann Collet–Meta copyright and the same BSD/GPL alternative. lib/dictBuilder/divsufsort.c/h carry Yuta Mori 2003-2008 MIT grant/disclaimer; legacy sources retain Yann Collet BSD-2-Clause notices. Retained source-copyright-notices.txt SHA256 24d5151291772e5b2f866a607175cd2bb50cfbfc1afb571054254213ee5cd122 includes these older BSD2/MIT notices but also zlibWrapper/tool notices; it misses at least the inspected modern xxhash header wording, so supplement from complete retained source rather than calling aggregate complete. The actual Meta LICENSE + exact modern xxhash + Mori MIT + enabled legacy BSD2 notice scope is the closure, not GPL SPDX alone.
Decision: elect BSD-3-Clause for zstd core, preserving independently applicable MIT/BSD2 notices. GNU corresponding-source/rebuild obligations are NOT mandatory for that selection. Missing installed PKGBUILD hash, different remote ELF, tar.gz/tar.zst discrepancy, unknown compiler flags and missing candidate manpage patch must remain truthful retained_audit_limitations, not universal blockers for BSD redistribution. Real notice extraction/attribution gaps remain actionable. No rebuild required just to elect BSD for this library. If parent voluntarily rebuilds exact -3 candidate, obtain its tar.zst and manpage patch first and identify output as a NEW owned build, not original -2 correspondence.
